slides.text: Pehli salary mein *yeh 3 kaam* pehle karo
*1.* Emergency fund shuru karo. *Alag account* mein.
*3.* Mehnga loan ya credit card due *pehle* utaro.
Thoda enjoy karo, par *plan ke saath*.
Kisi ke kehne par *stock ya scheme* mein paisa mat lagao.
Save karo. Pehli salary par dobara padhna.

caption:
Pehli salary ke baad kuch simple steps: emergency fund, kharcha track karo, mehnga loan pehle.

Pehli salary mein tumne kya kiya? Batao.
